__comment: all blocks pulled or pushed by magnets. Every convention-tag reference below is optional, and each is preceded by the vanilla items it would have contributed. Fabric API's convention-tags module ships a DIFFERENT subset of these on every build it has ever made — 1.20.1's pin has no c:ingots/iron, 1.20.5's and 1.21's have no c:nuggets/iron, none of them has ever had c:ores/iron — and a required reference to a tag that does not exist makes the WHOLE tag fail to load, taking alexscaves:galena_gauntlet_crystallization_items down with it. Optional references keep every other mod's iron on the loaders that do define these, while vanilla's own iron stays magnetic everywhere. forge:ores/iron stays required here because this mod defines the block half of it itself (data/forge/tags/blocks/ores/iron.json), so it exists on every loader.
